segments.title: Chương 50: 0050 [Bạn bè QQ của tôi khắp nơi]
segments.content:
Cheng Tao Computer Shop.

Feng Tao was replacing the screen on a MacBook, taking the opportunity to explain the key points to his apprentice and assistant.

The apprentice listened with rapt attention. After all, he rarely had the chance to work on a laptop, let alone an expensive MacBook.

Bian Guanyue sat to the side, watching as well.

Even though she couldn't understand any of it.

"You're Boss Feng's nephew?" The guy from the neighboring electronics accessories stall came over to offer a cigarette.

Chen Guiliang took it, baffled. "Yeah."

The man asked, "That game of yours, did you sell it for five or six hundred thousand, or over a million?"

Chen Guiliang: "????"

The man laughed. "Don't hide it. The news that you made a game and sold it to a big coastal company has already spread all over this floor. The only thing people can't agree on is how much you earned. Was it hundreds of thousands or a million?"

Chen Guiliang turned his head to look at his cousin-uncle, Feng Tao.

Feng Tao quickly turned away and said to his apprentice, "See this? This is called the display cable..."

Bian Guanyue's attention was also diverted, and she looked at Chen Guiliang curiously.

Chen Guiliang sighed. "I did hide something. The game actually sold for ten million."

"For real? You're bullshitting, right?" The man was skeptical instead, and even began to doubt if Chen Guiliang had sold a game at all.

Bian Guanyue pursed her lips and stifled a laugh. She knew that Great Hero Chen was bluffing again.

Chen Guiliang's words and gestures grew more exaggerated. He held the cigarette in his left hand and thrust it forward. "You know Shanda and NetEase, right?"

The man nodded. "I know them."

Chen Guiliang said, "Both of them wanted to buy my game. They nearly got into a fight over it. I got sick of it and couldn't be bothered to talk to them anymore, so I turned around and sold the game to Sina."

"Why don't you just say you're the President of the United States?" the man said, amused.

Chen Guiliang said, "I've actually chatted with the US President on QQ. His QQ nickname is 'Bright Red Scarf'."

"Then did you add Saddam's QQ?" the man asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "I added him last year. The internet cables over in Iraq got bombed, so I lost contact with Little Sa. I was even planning to remind him to be careful. Ai, I didn't expect him to get captured just like that. Last night, I left a message for Little Bush on QQ, telling him to let Saddam off the hook as a favor. We're all friends, why make things so ugly?"

The man continued to play along. "What did Little Bush say?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Little Bush said it's difficult for him too. The US is a total mess, and sometimes he's not the one calling the shots. He was afraid I'd get angry and even offered to top up my Q-coins for me. I told him there's no need, CEO Ma from Tencent is also my friend. CEO Ma already promised me that he'd give me a hundred million Q-coins as a birthday gift."

The man roared with laughter and shouted at Feng Tao, "Feng Tao, your nephew is a fucking good bullshitter! The son of a bitch has talked the hind legs off a cow!"

Bian Guanyue had been listening the whole time. Now, she was bowing her head, covering her mouth, her shoulders shaking slightly as she tried to hold back her laughter.

She really did have a low boiling point for humor and was always amused by Chen Guiliang.

"Boss, do you have a phone charger?" a customer called out.

The man immediately dropped Chen Guiliang and went back to his own shop to rip someone off. "A universal charger, one hundred yuan each."

The customer picked up the universal charger and looked at it. "This thing costs a hundred yuan?"

"Don't be fooled by its simple appearance, it's actually a high-tech product. There are so many kinds of phones, have you ever seen a universal charger before? You haven't, right? Let me tell you, this was invented by a Chinese person. You won't find it for sale even if you go abroad!"

"American technology is so advanced, they can't even invent a single charger?"

"America has chargers, but their chargers can't charge all models of phones. This universal charger was invented by a Chinese high school student. He even won first prize in the National Youth Science and Technology Innovation Competition and got a direct admission to Tsinghua this year!"

"That amazing?"

"If you don't believe me, look at this magazine. It just happened this summer."

"He really is a high school student. Can you make it a bit cheaper?"

"I'll give it to you for 90 yuan, can't go any lower. This thing was invented not too long ago, and production hasn't ramped up yet. It's out of stock everywhere in the country."

"How about 5 yuan?"

"..."

The bargaining continued next door, which made Chen Guiliang chuckle.

Feng Tao had finished replacing the laptop screen and said to Bian Guanyue, "Classmate, come and try it out."

Bian Guanyue turned it on and off two or three times, then checked the screen for any damage. After confirming there were no issues, she was quite excited. "Thank you, boss!"

"You're welcome. You're Guiliang's classmate. If you have any computer problems in the future, you can always come to me."

As he spoke, Feng Tao had already taken out the POS machine.

He really didn't overcharge an acquaintance, only tearfully making 100 yuan. That was already very generous.

If it weren't one of Chen Guiliang's classmates, his profit margin would have been at least three to five hundred yuan. If he ran into a rich fool, he could have made one or two thousand.

He swiped the card for payment and wrote out a receipt.

Feng Tao said, "It's almost noon. Stay and have lunch with us. The boxed meals from downstairs are pretty good."

"Sure, Cousin-uncle's treat," Chen Guiliang said with a smile.

"I can still afford boxed meals," Feng Tao said to his apprentice. "What are you still standing there for? Go downstairs and buy the boxed meals."

"Oh."

The apprentice was a bit clueless, but he knew to ask Bian Guanyue, "Miss, do you eat spicy food?"

Bian Guanyue said, "Slightly spicy."

Slightly spicy in Longdu was at least medium spicy or more in Rongcheng.

Chen Guiliang had eaten many regional cuisines in his past life. When it came to spiciness, Longdu and Pingxiang still ranked at the top, a veritable duo of "spice capitals" in China.

The apprentice quickly brought back the boxed meals, and the four of them sat in the shop, eating and chatting.

Chen Guiliang saw that Bian Guanyue's box didn't have any houttuynia and asked, "Want some? I haven't started eating yet."

"Mhm."

Bian Guanyue picked up her chopsticks and took a few stalks from Chen Guiliang's lunchbox.

As a matter of courtesy, Chen Guiliang also reached into her box for some braised pork.

Bian Guanyue suddenly realized something, glanced at Feng Tao and the apprentice, and quickly lowered her head to focus on her food, though the tips of her ears turned a little red.

His PHS phone rang. It was Tao Chenggang calling.

Chen Guiliang answered the phone, "Hello, Brother Gang... hello, hello... Damn! Cousin-uncle, how is the signal in the city worse than at our school?"

"It's darkest under the lamp."

Feng Tao explained, "The PHS signal station for this area is installed on the roof of the department store, so the inside of the building has actually become a signal dead zone."

"Let me use your phone," Chen Guiliang said.

Feng Tao pointed behind him. "There's a landline over there."

Chen Guiliang ran over and dialed the landline number. "Brother Gang, the PHS didn't have a signal just now."

"Is this the landline from Feng Tao's shop?"

"I'm with a friend to get a computer repaired."

After some small talk, Tao Chenggang got to the point. "The major private server hubs have started taking down their download services one after another. Some are even deleting posts on a large scale, afraid they'll get arrested and thrown in jail. Damn it, there are still ten days before the special operation, and they're all scared shitless."

"We'll just go with the flow," Chen Guiliang said.

Tao Chenggang said, "We can't advertise anymore, and the downloads have been cut off, but the private server still has to go on. We can only contact more internet cafes on gaming forums and find other ways to attract new players through them."

"I'll listen to whatever you say, Brother Gang, as long as we don't stand out," Chen Guiliang said.

Tao Chenggang laughed. "Who would dare to stand out now? I'm scared too, alright? Since you're in the city, come over for a drink with your cousin-uncle tonight."

Chen Guiliang declined politely. "We're in our third year of high school. We only get a two-day break at the end of the month. We usually only get one day off on weekends. We have to rush back for evening self-study tonight."

"Alright, I won't hold up your studies. Hanging up."

The major private server platforms were all spooked now.

There were some bolder ones, but seeing their peers back down, they could only follow suit and lay low, afraid that a single misstep would make them the nail that sticks out.

The Abyss private server would continue to operate, but it would no longer be publicly promoted, and it would be very difficult to find a direct download link online.

When five government departments made a move, everyone had to show some respect.

"Cousin-uncle, goodbye, and thanks for the boxed meal."

"Not staying a little longer?"

"I won't disturb you from getting customers."

"Get lost!"

"Hahahaha."

While Chen Guiliang was joking with his cousin-uncle, Bian Guanyue shouldered her laptop bag and thanked Feng Tao very solemnly.

The two went downstairs.

Bian Guanyue finally couldn't help but ask, "Are you in business with that Brother Gang?"

This question had been bottled up inside her for half a month. She had seen Chen Guiliang making calls to communicate several times.

Chen Guiliang told the truth. "Brother Gang is Tao Xue's older brother. We're running a private server together to make a little money. You still remember Tao Xue, right? The one who often comes to discuss literature with me."

"I remember. What's a private server?" Bian Guanyue asked.

Chen Guiliang asked back, "Have you ever played an online game?"

Bian Guanyue said, "When I was studying in Rongcheng, a friend dragged me to play Fantasy Westward Journey 2." After saying that, she added, "She was a very close female classmate."

Chen Guiliang said, "A private server is a game that's run privately, bypassing the game company."

"Isn't that illegal?" Bian Guanyue asked worriedly.

Chen Guiliang said, "It violates copyright law. If you're running a private server for a domestically developed game, you'll definitely get sued successfully. But if it's for a foreign game that's being licensed, there's currently no legislation regarding the rights and responsibilities of the licensed operator."

"A legal gray area?"

"Right. At most, you'll get a fine if you're caught, and you might not even have to forfeit your profits."

Knowing what Chen Guiliang was doing, and after making sure there was no danger, Bian Guanyue stopped prying.

She didn't even ask how much Chen Guiliang had earned.

The two took a bus to the long-distance bus station. Bian Guanyue proactively went to buy the tickets.

Chen Guiliang's PHS rang again.

The signal was good this time.

"Hello, my big nephew, this is your Auntie Tao."

"Hello, Auntie Xue."

"My brother said you're in the city. Are you going back to school now?"

"Yeah, I'm already at the bus station."

"I'm going back to school too. Wait for me for a few minutes. I'll take a taxi and be there soon."

"Uh..."

Chen Guiliang looked at Bian Guanyue who was walking back with the tickets and said with some helplessness, "Then hurry up, I'm about to get on the bus."

"Five minutes at most... Sir, stop... Ah, I hailed it first... This is infuriating, someone stole my taxi. I'll call another one, seven or eight minutes at most!"

"Hanging up. Contact me when you get to the bus station."

Bian Guanyue handed over the bus ticket and had also bought two bottles of drinks.

"I'll go buy another ticket," Chen Guiliang said.

Bian Guanyue asked, "Someone else is coming?"

Chen Guiliang sighed. "Tao Xue is going back to school too. She's already on her way in a taxi."

"Oh."

Bian Guanyue's expression didn't change much, but there was a hint of unhappiness in her heart because a third wheel had suddenly appeared.

*Can we please fast forward to the "but I was here first" part?*
